title: Unannounced Oneiric Escape Room (Client Project)
subtitle: Gameplay & Systems Engineer
description: This yet-to-be-announced game is an Arabic styled escape room-like game where the player will have to solve riddles in a oneiric palace to unveil the mysteries hidden in it. In this game I performed mainly level design tasks, as well as maintenance ones.

title: Bion Clash
subtitle: Gameplay & Systems Engineer
description: Bion Clash is a social party royale MMO. It is set in a low-poly Futurama inspired world where players can explore, socialize and even compete in frenzied minigames. This game uses most of the modular reusable systems I worked on in The Prison. Besides that, I took care of gameplay programming, as well as backend and game maintenance.

title: Oblivio
subtitle: Gameplay & Systems Engineer
description: Oblivio is a strongly narrative game heavily inspired by Alice's Adventures in Wonderland. It tells the story of a person suffering alzheimer who sees how their memories fade. In this game I took care mainly of gameplay programming and maintenance tasks.

title: Denbora
subtitle: Gameplay & Systems Engineer
description: Denbora is a puzzle game strongly inspired by Portal where, instead of portals, players have to use time jumps between two points in time to solve test chambers. If they are to succeed, they will have to understand how actions in the past affect the future, but not the opposite. In this game I mainly took care of gameplay mechanics programming, as well as maintenance and QA tasks.

title: The Prison
subtitle: Gameplay & Systems Engineer
description: Based on Dinamic Multimedia 's La prisión, The Prison is a social MMO set in a prison where players have to forge alliances and fight each other to gain control of the territory. In this project, I took care of the architecture design and implementation of Quests and Factions systems, as well as the maintenance of existing systems. The tasks performed involve all the life cycle of the data, from the database holding the data and the backend serving it to the Unreal Engine application generating and representing it.
